title: Witness Coil
text: Witness Coil records every movement in hot wire and lashes out when two accounts disagree. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It trusts the burn mark more than the witness.

defeatReward.text: Witness Coil is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
